title: Chance Triple Alignment: Plane, Space Station, Sun
explanation:
# A Cosmic Coincidence

A photographer in the Czech Republic captured an extraordinarily rare moment in June: the Sun, the International Space Station, and a passing airplane all aligned in a single frame—a feat so improbable that odds estimate it occurs only once in 30 million attempts from any given location. While the sunspots and the space station were expected guests in this celestial portrait, the airplane's unexpected silhouette transformed a planned observation into an astonishing snapshot of three objects at vastly different distances creating a perfect cosmic alignment.
